meta.name: prototype-coach
meta.description: Guide prototyping for solo game dev. Use when deciding what to prototype, scoping a prototype, evaluating results, or deciding whether to kill or commit. Prevents both over-investment in prototypes and skipping prototyping entirely.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 决定原型做什么、怎么评估,以及是否继续
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让游戏原型投入恰到好处,不盲目也能推进
copy.tagline_en: Decide what to prototype, how to scope it, and whether to continue
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to validate game ideas without over-investing or skipping prototyping

howto.what: Claude会引导你快速制作和评估游戏原型：在动手前帮你写下要验证的问题、时间上限和失败标准，制作中禁止添加特效和扩大范围，制作后评估结果并更新设计文档，最后决定保留或删除原型。
howto.when: 当你需要决定做什么原型、规划原型范围、评估原型结果，或犹豫该放弃还是继续时触发。

say.text: 我想验证钩爪移动手感，帮我定个原型计划。
say.note: Claude会先让你写清问题、时间盒和失败标准。

say.text: 原型时间到了，帮我对失败标准评估结果。
say.note: Claude会引导你判断是继续还是砍掉，并记录发现。

say.text: 帮我创建一张Spike工单，写明问题、时间盒和失败标准。
say.note: 直接生成冲刺工单描述，可用于敏捷流程。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through game prototyping: before building, help you state the question, set time box and kill criteria; during building, remind you to skip polish and scope creep; after building, evaluate results, update the GDD, and decide whether to keep or delete the prototype.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to decide what to prototype, scope a prototype, evaluate results, or decide whether to kill or commit.

say_en.text: I want to test grappling hook movement, help me plan a prototype.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the question, time box, and kill criteria.

say_en.text: Time's up, help me evaluate against the kill criteria.
say_en.note: Claude will guide pass/fail and record findings.

say_en.text: Create a Spike ticket with question, time box, and kill criteria.
